goal: Rust-own current-C public bound-fd selection without requiring DS4_CUDA_WEIGHT_CACHE, including preload continuation and explicit fd disablement, while leaving remaining failure selection and route promotion pending.

semantics: after global model/direct and retained-range lookups, current C attempts a bound model fd whenever DS4_CUDA_NO_FD_CACHE is absent
the fd-selection guard does not require DS4_CUDA_WEIGHT_CACHE and is reached even when DS4_CUDA_WEIGHT_PRELOAD is set
setting DS4_CUDA_NO_FD_CACHE bypasses fd staging and continues into registration or host-to-device copy fallback

implementation.selection_path: fd_weight_cache_selected now requires only that fd caching is not disabled and direct-host bypass is not selected, preserving buffered fd staging for a bound fd without the historical weight-cache flag
implementation.corrected_predecessor_boundary: the buffered-fd predecessor checker now treats DS4_CUDA_WEIGHT_CACHE as its observation setup rather than as the current-C fd eligibility contract
implementation.remaining_policy_boundary: remaining residual failure selection, q8/f16 hooks, remaining compute exports, and route promotion stay pending

integration_risks: the linked consumer proves buffered public fd selection on B300 after deterministic whole-map registration rejection with interposed CUDA error code 801; the prior direct-I/O fd path remains covered by its predecessor artifact
the no-fd-cache case proves selection bypass and observes fallback output, but remaining allocation or transfer failure branches are not forced in this consumer
remaining model-control failure selection, q8/f16 hooks, production linker selection, and C CUDA removal remain pending
the generated embed object still produces an executable-stack linker warning before route promotion
